questions.explanation:
Strong reducing agents are those that readily donate electrons, and strong oxidizing agents are those that readily accept electrons.

  • : It can accept an electron to form , so it is a strong oxidizing agent.

  • : It can donate an electron to form , so it is a strong reducing agent.

So the correct answer is: and .
